confirmSignup.subject: Confirm your Tradelia account
confirmSignup.mainContent: Thank you for signing up. Please confirm your email address to activate your account.
confirmSignup.footerText: If you didn't create this account, you can safely ignore this email.
confirmSignup.altText: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:

magicLink.subject: Your Tradelia magic link
magicLink.mainContent: Click the button below to sign in to your account. This link will expire in 1 hour.
magicLink.footerText: If you didn't request this link, you can safely ignore this email.

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email address
changeEmail.mainContent: You requested to change your email address. Please confirm your new email address to complete the change.
changeEmail.footerText: If you didn't request this change, please contact support immediately.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Tradelia password
resetPassword.mainContent: You requested to reset your password. Click the button below to create a new password.
resetPassword.footerText: If you didn't request this reset, you can safely ignore this email.
